cards.label: Biggest commercialization implication
cards.headline: Evidence requirements may reshape product economics
cards.detail: If prospective and continuous validation expand beyond the highest-risk applications, lower-value GenAI products may require more capital or higher contract values to remain viable.

cards.label: Biggest deployment implication
cards.headline: Clearance may not be enough
cards.detail: Commenters point toward local assurance obligations tied to workflow, configuration, population, and ongoing model change.
